game.title: Lego Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga
game.blurb: LEGO action-adventure covering all nine Star Wars episodes, with an open galaxy of planets to explore, from TT Games, released 2022-04-05. RAWG average playtime: 7 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, Platformer. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Episodes I to III
chapters.summary: Finishing The Phantom Menace, Attack of the Clones and Revenge of the Sith.

chapters.title: Episodes IV to VI
chapters.summary: Finishing A New Hope, The Empire Strikes Back and Return of the Jedi.

chapters.title: Episodes VII to IX and the Whole Saga
chapters.summary: Finishing The Force Awakens, The Last Jedi and The Rise of Skywalker, then the whole saga.

chapters.title: True Jedi, Challenges and Minikits
chapters.summary: True Jedi, level challenges and minikits, for one level and for all of them, plus a flight level without dying.

chapters.title: The Galaxy and Its Planets
chapters.summary: Finishing every event on each group of planets, races, galaxy challenges, creatures, and side missions such as the Jawa droids and GNK escorts.

chapters.title: Characters, Upgrades and Studs
chapters.summary: Collecting characters, datacards and Kyber Bricks, upgrading character classes and earning studs.

chapters.title: Combat and Fun
chapters.summary: Explosions, shooting off helmets, TIE fighters, disguises, combat multipliers and mind tricks in the Cantina.

StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/LEGO_Star_Wars:_The_Skywalker_Saga
Fandom (starwars.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/LEGO_Star_Wars:_The_Skywalker_Saga
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page under the title "LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga" (completion stage 0; the "Lego" spelling gave no page). Its Walkthrough, Gameplay and "Achievements and trophies" subpages are linked but not written; only "Controls" and "Table of Contents" are written, so nothing was used. lego.fandom.com gave no page; Wookieepedia (starwars.fandom.com) answers the API under "LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga", with 500 or more linked pages (the list was cut off at 500), mostly characters, ships and places; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 45 Steam achievements is hidden. The nine episode achievements were grouped by trilogy; the planet-group achievements (for example "The Arkanis Sector", "Unknown Regions") use region names from the achievement text. The RAWG slug is spelled "lego-star-wars-the-sywalker-saga" on RAWG itself.
